arguments.request: validate payment callback URL against allowed origins

request: Add a function that rejects payment callback URLs whose origin isn't permitted by the configured callback URL rules.

summary.result_text:
I added `check_callback_url(url)` to `lnbits/helpers.py`. It raises `ValueError` when a callback URL isn't allowed, and returns `None` when it is. I haven't run the tests. The pcat check found no deviations from the catalog pattern.

The function does the following:
- **Basic checks:** it rejects URLs that aren't `http` or `https`, that have no host, that carry a username or password, or that have an invalid port.
- **Origin rules:** it builds the origin (scheme, lowercased host and optional port) and requires a full regex match against one of the `lnbits_callback_url_rules` settings. An invalid regex rule is logged and skipped. If no rules are configured, any URL that passes the basic checks is allowed.

`lnbits/helpers.py` already had a function called `check_webhook_url`, but no `check_callback_url`. Several modules already import `check_callback_url` from `lnbits.helpers`, so I replaced the old function with the new one. Nothing else referenced the old name. That function only checked the `http(s)://` prefix and matched the rules against the whole URL with `re.match`, so a rule like `https://example\.com` would also have allowed `https://example.com.evil.net`.

One behaviour change for admins: rules now match against the origin only, with no path, so any existing rule that includes a path will stop matching.
